method: Built-in ImageGen, native orthographic source; broad projected hardscape removed

records.prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Produce a material-realistic TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC architectural Front ELEVATION from this exact SketchUp orthographic export. This is a technical elevation rendered with realistic materials, NOT a perspective photograph. Keep exact geometry, outline, door/window counts and coordinates, camera direction and framing. Rays are horizontal and parallel, no downward look, no vanishing point. 
CRITICAL: ALL HORIZONTAL DRIVEWAY AND LAWN TOP SURFACES ARE EDGE-ON in this view. They must NOT appear as broad visible areas in foreground. Keep ONLY the very thin horizontal site edge EXACTLY as in input, approximately 73% down image. Nothing resembling a broad driveway rectangle, trapezoid, L shape, diagonal paving boundary or grass field below building. Do NOT invent an apron in front of garage doors. The source white edge is thin terrain slab edge; preserve it. The small exposed gray driveway edge below entry stays ONLY that thin segment shown in source. The L-shaped drive exists in plan but its top face is NOT VISIBLE in this true elevation.
Below this exact ground baseline keep a clean off-white blank presentation background, not landscape or ground-plane perspective. Above baseline use pale light blue sky, subtle small clouds; a few VERY distant small tree silhouettes at far sides behind house are acceptable but must not hide architecture. Thin natural grass fringe no more than a few pixels at grade on modeled lawn segments, no grass carpet foreground.
Materials preserve source assignments exactly: white wirecut brick, pale off-white splitface entry stone, light gray smooth accent panels, white VERTICAL board-and-batten where present, charcoal asphalt shingle HIP roofs, white fascia/soffits, black doors/window frames/garage doors, existing black deck. Enhance natural textures, realistic soft daylight and glass reflections. Do not add or remove windows, parapets or floors. Roof shape must be exact original source silhouette. No roof redesign. No text/labels/watermark. Landscape 2400x1500; identical source composition.
